variation: Bilateral seated dumbbell shoulder press with upright back support and palms forward.
camera: Front three-quarter, athlete facing slightly left; both hands and weights clearly visible.
equipment: Fixed upright bench with dark padding, two identical modest round dumbbells.
anchors: Head position fixed; trunk and pelvis supported against backrest
invariants: Dumbbell head diameter and handle length

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Sit supported, palms forward, wrists over elbows.
frames.state: Upright supported seated start; elbows below hands, dumbbells at shoulder level.

frames.label: Begin press
frames.cue: Press upward while keeping your trunk braced.
frames.state: Small press; elbows extend slightly, shoulder flexion increases.

frames.label: Continue press
frames.cue: Extend elbows without leaning away from support.
frames.state: Halfway press; upper arms rise and elbows extend.

frames.label: Top position
frames.cue: Reach overhead without knocking the weights together.
frames.state: Comfortable overhead endpoint, elbows near straight; no contact between weights.

frames.label: Controlled lower
frames.cue: Lower both dumbbells slowly under control.

frames.label: Finish lowering
frames.cue: Return towards shoulder height with wrists straight.
frames.state: Same as 2 on return; transition to 1 continues lowering.
